commitResults.messageTitle: AGENTS.md: Update student profile with experience and IDE
Rename project and main class from Duke to Bob
commitResults.messageBody:
"Duke" was the temporary name across the codebase and documentation. Renamed to "Bob"

Let's:
* Rename Duke.java to Bob.java and update class declaration
* Update project title and references in top-level README.md and docs/README.md
* Update the ASCII art banner to reflect the name "Bob"

commitResults.messageTitle: Add echo feature and exit on bye
Add marking and unmarking tasks feature
Add task types and input validation

commitResults.messageBody:
Document the project's style hierarchy, Codex workflow, and
validation expectations for future development.

Add reusable prompts for planning, implementing, reviewing, and
debugging project changes, and update the README and UI test plan
for the Gradle-based workflow.

Save the current task list to data/Bob.txt after every successful add, mark, unmark, and delete operation. Document the save behavior and verified console workflow in the UI test plan; loading and error handling remain for later increments.

Read serialized tasks from data/Bob.txt when Bob starts.

Reconstruct todo, deadline, and event tasks while preserving their completion
status. Update the UI test plan with file fixtures and startup-loading coverage.

Add graceful handling for missing, malformed, unreadable, and unwritable task
data files.

Start with an empty list when the data file is missing, report storage errors
without terminating Bob, and extend the UI test plan with error-case coverage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse and format deadline and event dates
commitResults.messageBody: Parse date and local date-time inputs into LocalDate or LocalDateTime values for deadlines and events. Format stored values with readable day and month names, and update UI test coverage for date and time handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add missing exception and date parsing classes
Handle invalid date and time input
commitResults.messageBody:
Report invalid deadline and event date/time details as user-facing errors without terminating Bob.
Add UI coverage for malformed input and invalid saved date formatting.

Add the upcoming [days] command with a default seven-day range. Filter deadlines and event start dates, sort matching tasks chronologically, and validate command arguments. Update the UI test plan with comprehensive coverage.

Add the on date command to list deadlines and events scheduled for a specified date.
Include events spanning the date, sort matching tasks chronologically, validate date arguments, and update UI test coverage.

Add the overdue command to list incomplete deadlines whose due dates or times have passed.
Exclude completed deadlines, events, and Todo items, sort results chronologically, validate command arguments, and update UI test coverage.

Move console input handling and user-facing output from Bob into Ui.
Keep command processing and task filtering in Bob while preserving behavior.
Record the successful 19-case UI test session.

Tests:
- gradlew.bat clean check --rerun-tasks
- All 19 UI cases passed

Encapsulate task storage, indexing, addition, and deletion in TaskList.
Update Bob to use TaskList instead of managing the task collection directly.
Preserve existing command behavior and UI output.

Tests:

Move task creation and command-argument validation from Bob into Parser.
Keep command dispatch in Bob while preserving existing behavior and UI output.
Record the successful UI test session.

Tests:

Add Command to represent recognized user actions.
Move command recognition into Parser and replace Bob's string-based

Preserve existing behavior and UI output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete UI verification for OOP changes

commitResults.messageBody:
Move application classes under the student.project.bob package hierarchy.

Group task models, parsing, storage, UI, utilities, and exceptions into
dedicated subpackages. Update imports, the Gradle main class, README, and UI
test commands to use the new fully qualified entry point.

Integrate the requested Gradle support without replacing the current Bob application. Add the Shadow plugin, JUnit 5 dependencies, test logging, and executable fat JAR configuration. Regenerate the Gradle wrapper for Gradle 9.7.1 while retaining the Java 25 toolchain, Spotless validation, and student.project.bob.Bob as the application entry point.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for task index validation
commitResults.messageBody:
Add comprehensive tests for TaskList.getIndex, covering valid indexes,
invalid task numbers, malformed arguments, and empty task lists.

Verify the changes with Gradle and the documented UI test suite.
Test task-list construction, mutation, access, streaming, and read-only views. Preserve comprehensive validation of task-number conversion and error cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for task state
commitResults.messageBody: Verify task initialization, status display, description access, and idempotent done and undone transitions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for todo formatting
commitResults.messageBody: Verify todo type prefixes and completed or incomplete status formatting.
Verify deadline date and date-time parsing, formatting, completion status, and invalid input handling.
Verify event date and date-time ranges, accessors, completion formatting, and invalid endpoint handling.
Verify command types and input text are preserved across command construction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for parser behavior
commitResults.messageBody: Verify command classification, task creation, date parsing, upcoming ranges, and parser error messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for date-time parsing
commitResults.messageBody: Verify all supported date and date-time representations, display formats, invalid input, and unsupported temporal types.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for task storage
commitResults.messageBody: Verify isolated save and load round trips, UTF-8 data, missing and malformed files, overwrites, and storage failures.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for console UI
commitResults.messageBody: Verify input trimming, command availability, task displays, confirmations, separators, and error messages through captured console streams.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for Bob command loop
commitResults.messageBody: Verify entry-point startup, task lifecycle commands, date queries, invalid commands, malformed saved data, and save failures in isolated processes.
Document the successful run of all 19 command-line UI test cases after completing the JUnit suite.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadocs to Bob task APIs
commitResults.messageBody:
Several public members in Bob's entry point and task model lack complete
documentation.

Add Javadocs for the application entry point, task constructors, state
mutators, and task string representations to satisfy the a-javadoc stretch
goal without changing runtime behavior.
